body_markdown:
Under Armour today announced[Protect This Mind](https://about.underarmour.com/en/Purpose/impact/protect-this-mind.html) , a mental wellness initiative building on the brand’s work with high school student-athletes through[Project Rampart](https://about.underarmour.com/en/Purpose/impact/project-rampart.html) . With NFL professional football player Damar Hamlin serving as its athlete ambassador, the platform brings together free mental wellness resources, peer-to-peer support, and expert-backed training for coaches and educators to better help young athletes navigate the pressures of sport, school and everyday life.


Through its work with student-athletes in Baltimore, Oakland and Washington, D.C., Under Armour has heard a consistent need for more practical tools and trusted support for mental wellbeing. Protect This Mind responds to that feedback, reaching students through Project Rampart partner high schools and making resources available more broadly through a free online hub.
